releases.title: MC 26.3 与键鼠适配大幅完善
releases.titleEn: Major Minecraft 26.3 and keyboard/mouse compatibility update

entries.text: Minecraft 26.3 的可玩性继续提升：Snapshot 9 与 Pre-Release 1 已在目标设备完成启动、主菜单、世界加载、画面和输入验证。
entries.markdown: **Minecraft 26.3 的可玩性继续提升**：Snapshot 9 与 Pre-Release 1 已在目标设备完成启动、主菜单、世界加载、画面和输入验证。
details: 补齐新版必需的 SPNG Java 与 OpenHarmony 原生模块，并修复 OIT、着色器翻译缓存、SDL3 多窗口和输入激活等连续阻塞。
应用切换到后台再返回后，窗口与输入能够恢复。

entries.text: 物理键鼠适配完成核心链路重构：统一键盘、鼠标按钮、滚轮、视角与失焦恢复的事件通道，改善输入一致性；当前可玩范围见下方“注意”。
entries.markdown: **物理键鼠适配完成核心链路重构**：统一键盘、鼠标按钮、滚轮、视角与失焦恢复的事件通道，改善输入一致性；当前可玩范围见下方“注意”。
details: 物理鼠标不再套用为触屏抖动设计的平滑，减少停止移动后的视角拖尾感。

entries.text: JDK 更新系统：已安装但版本较旧的 JDK 不再一律判定为不可用，用户可以自行决定是否更新。
entries.markdown: **JDK 更新系统**：已安装但版本较旧的 JDK 不再一律判定为不可用，用户可以自行决定是否更新。

entries.text: 从本地压缩包导入 JDK：支持离线安装和用户自带 JDK 包。
entries.markdown: **从本地压缩包导入 JDK**：支持离线安装和用户自带 JDK 包。

entries.text: 优化 MC 26.3 的地形上传、GPU 提交和单人区块发包节奏；目标设备已确认区块边界卡顿感明显减少，但不宣称所有设备和模组组合都已彻底解决。
MobileGlues 升级到 2.0 基线，并补齐源码、构建参数、HAP 内原生库与签名产物之间的可追溯校验。
建立统一的渲染后端注册与路由层，彻底退役不可用的 Zink 路径。
完成多输入端 typed 通道迁移，并增加事件投递、按键持有、滚轮量纲和焦点恢复等完整性检查。
修复 Minecraft 26.3 Pre-Release 1 因缺少 SPNG 模块而在启动早期退出。
修复 MC 26.3 着色器被错误重写、旧翻译缓存继续命中以及 OIT 输出不兼容造成的启动崩溃。
修复 SDL3 辅助窗口触发“只支持一个窗口”、菜单完全无响应以及第一次点击只移动光标的问题。
修复 Fabric 各版本因游戏 classpath 缺失而启动即崩溃。
修复加入 IPv6 服务器失败，并更新 JDK 8、17、21、25 的 IPv6 沙箱兼容组件。
修复 Release 包中版本列表、模组列表和正版登录因属性名混淆而失效的问题。
修复 GC 日志相对路径导致 JVM 创建失败、游戏完全无法启动的问题。
修复物理滚轮方向、量纲、首格重复、焦点释放和部分输入事件无法送达后端的问题。
修复 Release 构建中的帧率调度接口失效，并移除出货包内不应携带的测试代码。
物理键鼠目前仅在 HarmonyOS 7（API 26）设备上验证可玩；HarmonyOS 6（API 24）及其他较低系统版本可能遇到鼠标按键、视角或滚轮问题。
entries.markdown: **物理键鼠目前仅在 HarmonyOS 7（API 26）设备上验证可玩**；HarmonyOS 6（API 24）及其他较低系统版本可能遇到鼠标按键、视角或滚轮问题。

entries.text: MC 26.2 搭配 Sodium 仍有已知问题：部分设备可能出现地形错乱或严重卡顿；原版 26.x 不受该组合问题影响。
entries.markdown: **MC 26.2 搭配 Sodium 仍有已知问题**：部分设备可能出现地形错乱或严重卡顿；原版 26.x 不受该组合问题影响。

entries.text: MC 26.3 仍属于快照／预览版本，不保证所有后续快照、模组和设备均稳定。
Release 附件为 unsigned HAP，需要自行签名后侧载安装，推荐使用 HoKit。
entries.markdown: Release 附件为 **unsigned HAP**，需要自行签名后侧载安装，推荐使用 HoKit。

zh.summary: 本版继续完善 Minecraft 26.3 的 SDL3 运行链路，并集中重构物理键盘与鼠标输入，另外补齐 JDK 管理、IPv6 联机以及多项 Release 稳定性修复。

entries.text: Minecraft 26.3 continues to become more playable: Snapshot 9 and Pre-Release 1 have been validated through launch, the main menu, world loading, rendering and input on target devices.
entries.markdown: **Minecraft 26.3 continues to become more playable**: Snapshot 9 and Pre-Release 1 have been validated through launch, the main menu, world loading, rendering and input on target devices.
details: Added the required SPNG Java and OpenHarmony native modules, and fixed successive blockers in OIT, shader translation caches, SDL3 multi-window handling and input activation.
Window and input state now recover after backgrounding and returning to the app.

entries.text: The core physical keyboard and mouse path has been rebuilt: keyboard, mouse button, wheel, look and focus-loss handling now use a unified event path; see Notes below for the currently validated system range.
entries.markdown: **The core physical keyboard and mouse path has been rebuilt**: keyboard, mouse button, wheel, look and focus-loss handling now use a unified event path; see Notes below for the currently validated system range.
details: Physical mouse input no longer uses touch-oriented smoothing, reducing trailing movement after the mouse stops.

entries.text: JDK update management: an installed but older JDK is no longer automatically treated as unusable, and the user can choose whether to update it.
entries.markdown: **JDK update management**: an installed but older JDK is no longer automatically treated as unusable, and the user can choose whether to update it.

entries.text: Local JDK archive import for offline installation and user-provided packages.
entries.markdown: **Local JDK archive import** for offline installation and user-provided packages.

entries.text: Improved terrain uploads, GPU submission and single-player chunk delivery in Minecraft 26.3. Device testing shows noticeably reduced chunk-boundary stutter, but this does not claim that every device and mod combination is completely fixed.
Upgraded MobileGlues to the 2.0 baseline with reproducible source, build, HAP and signing provenance checks.
Introduced a central renderer registry and routing layer, and completely retired the unusable Zink path.
Completed the typed multi-backend input migration with delivery, held-state, wheel-unit and focus-recovery checks.
Minecraft 26.3 Pre-Release 1 exiting early because the SPNG module was missing.
Minecraft 26.3 launch failures caused by shader rewriting, stale translation caches and OIT output incompatibilities.
SDL3 auxiliary-window failures, unresponsive menus and the first click only moving the cursor.
Fabric versions crashing at launch because the game classpath was unavailable.
Failure to join IPv6 servers, with updated sandbox compatibility components for JDK 8, 17, 21 and 25.
Version lists, mod lists and Microsoft login breaking in Release builds because JSON property names were obfuscated.
JVM creation failing because the GC log used a relative path.
Wheel direction, units, duplicated first detents, focus release and backend event-delivery problems.
Broken frame-rate scheduling interfaces in Release builds, and test-only code being included in shipping binaries.
Physical keyboard and mouse gameplay has currently only been validated on HarmonyOS 7 (API 26). HarmonyOS 6 (API 24) and other older system versions may encounter mouse button, look or wheel issues.
entries.markdown: **Physical keyboard and mouse gameplay has currently only been validated on HarmonyOS 7 (API 26)**. HarmonyOS 6 (API 24) and other older system versions may encounter mouse button, look or wheel issues.

entries.text: Minecraft 26.2 with Sodium still has known issues on some devices, including corrupted terrain and severe stutter. Vanilla 26.x is unaffected by this combination-specific issue.
entries.markdown: **Minecraft 26.2 with Sodium still has known issues** on some devices, including corrupted terrain and severe stutter. Vanilla 26.x is unaffected by this combination-specific issue.

entries.text: Minecraft 26.3 remains a snapshot/pre-release version and is not guaranteed to work with every later snapshot, mod or device.
The Release asset is an unsigned HAP and must be signed before sideloading; HoKit is recommended.
entries.markdown: The Release asset is an **unsigned HAP** and must be signed before sideloading; HoKit is recommended.

en.summary: This release continues the Minecraft 26.3 SDL3 work, rebuilds the physical keyboard and mouse path, and adds JDK management, IPv6 connectivity and Release stability fixes.

releases.title: MC 26.3 可进游戏，下载与日志链路大修
releases.titleEn: Minecraft 26.3 playable, download and logging overhaul

entries.text: MC 26.3（SDL3 时代）已可进入主菜单与世界：Mojang 从 26.3-snapshot-4 起把窗口 / 输入 / 平台集成从 GLFW 换成 SDL3，本版打通了这条新链路，真机可进主菜单、出画面、响应输入。
entries.markdown: **MC 26.3（SDL3 时代）已可进入主菜单与世界**：Mojang 从 26.3-snapshot-4 起把窗口 / 输入 / 平台集成从 GLFW 换成 SDL3，本版打通了这条新链路，真机可进主菜单、出画面、响应输入。
details: 之前是「点开就闪退」。三个串行阻塞逐个修掉：渲染后端在 SDL 时代不再被初始化（导致必崩）、26.3 新增的 OIT 着色器用了 GLSL ES 禁止的「非常量下标 fragment 输出数组」导致几乎所有着色器编译失败、以及输入桥跨 linker namespace 拿不到符号。

entries.text: 应用内更新日志：新增更新日志页面与全新的更新提示弹窗，可按分类查看每个版本的变更。
entries.markdown: **应用内更新日志**：新增更新日志页面与全新的更新提示弹窗，可按分类查看每个版本的变更。
details: 更新日志改为单一事实源：网页、GitHub Release、App 三处内容由同一份文本生成，不会再各说各话。

entries.text: AI 崩溃日志分析：崩溃后可一键分析，给出结论与技术详情（可展开查看完整日志），结果支持 Markdown 渲染。
entries.markdown: **AI 崩溃日志分析**：崩溃后可一键分析，给出结论与技术详情（可展开查看完整日志），结果支持 Markdown 渲染。
details: 分析与日志分享由 [logshare.cn](https://logshare.cn) 提供：同一处可把日志上传生成分享链接，反馈问题时直接附上即可。

entries.text: 活动账本：每条活动（下载 / 安装 / 修复 / 启动）都留一份完整、精确归属的记录。
entries.markdown: **活动账本**：每条活动（下载 / 安装 / 修复 / 启动）都留一份完整、精确归属的记录。

entries.text: 清掉渲染后端逐帧、逐上传路径上的驱动往返，并升级 MobileGlues。
下载速度显示不再「一会 MB 一会 KB 甚至 B」：改用累计字节时间差计算。
按主机选择 IP 地址族：IPv6 不可达的镜像不再拖慢整体下载。
安装加载器前不再干等 30 秒（校验文件探测改为并发 + 短超时），小文件也不再被切成多段各付一次握手。
重绘崩溃诊断版面，日志分享升为独立卡片。
下载速度问题根治：模组下载卡在 11.5KB/s、client.jar 收尾停 57 秒、加载器安装慢，三类问题分别定位到根因后修复。
entries.markdown: **下载速度问题根治**：模组下载卡在 11.5KB/s、`client.jar` 收尾停 57 秒、加载器安装慢，三类问题分别定位到根因后修复。
details: 模组下载：测速探针的结论被丢弃、硬写官方源优先，而官方源对部分设备 307 到一台连不通的主机。
收尾停顿：结尾阶段被 3~4 条 7KB/s 的僵尾连接独占，现放开收尾补段并支持相对低速抢占。
加载器安装：BMCLAPI 镜像 URL 多带一段路径导致恒 404、单段下载被低速看门狗反复掐死、安装器下载全程没有进度回调。

entries.text: 旧版 Forge（1.12.2 / 1.11.2 等）100% 装不上：安装器内部路径带前导斜杠被过严校验拦下。
entries.markdown: **旧版 Forge（1.12.2 / 1.11.2 等）100% 装不上**：安装器内部路径带前导斜杠被过严校验拦下。

entries.text: Fabric 安装会在版本列表里残留多余条目：Fabric 现在与 Forge / NeoForge 一样在安装沙箱里完成。
entries.markdown: **Fabric 安装会在版本列表里残留多余条目**：Fabric 现在与 Forge / NeoForge 一样在安装沙箱里完成。

entries.text: Forge 深度修复改走与全新安装同一条流水线，不再原地重跑安装器，成功率大幅提升。
entries.markdown: **Forge 深度修复改走与全新安装同一条流水线**，不再原地重跑安装器，成功率大幅提升。

entries.text: 日志系统三处严重缺陷：突发场景丢失 96.8% 日志、游戏日志每次启动被清空、崩溃诊断对健康会话给出破坏性建议且上传出口未脱敏。
MC 26.3 画面整体发白（sRGB 被编码两次）。
补齐 Release 构建中虚拟控制相关的原生接口。
一次启动崩溃（循环 import 下的模块级初始化顺序问题）。
MC 26.2 搭配钠（Sodium）这个模组仍有已知问题：部分设备上会出现地形错乱与严重卡顿，本版未能解决。原版（不装钠）的 26.x 不受影响。
entries.markdown: **MC 26.2 搭配钠（Sodium）这个模组仍有已知问题**：部分设备上会出现地形错乱与严重卡顿，本版未能解决。**原版（不装钠）的 26.x 不受影响。**
details: 本版已修好的相关问题：进入世界只剩 HUD、地形与材质透明成「虚空」、以及打开 F3 后的彩条遮挡。
地形错乱与卡顿本版做了多轮修法，全部在真机验证后被否证并回退，因此仍未解决；后续会继续跟进。

entries.text: MC 26.3 属于快照 / 预览版本，仍在适配中，可进入主菜单与世界但不保证稳定。
附件为 unsigned HAP，需自行签名后侧载安装。
entries.markdown: 附件为 **unsigned HAP**，需自行签名后侧载安装。

zh.summary: 本版打通了 MC 26.3 的 SDL3 时代，把「下载」与「日志」两条链路做了彻底大修，并让更新日志第一次进入 App 内。

entries.text: Minecraft 26.3 (the SDL3 era) now reaches the main menu and worlds: from 26.3-snapshot-4 Mojang replaced GLFW with SDL3 for windowing, input and platform integration; this release brings that path up on device.
entries.markdown: **Minecraft 26.3 (the SDL3 era) now reaches the main menu and worlds**: from 26.3-snapshot-4 Mojang replaced GLFW with SDL3 for windowing, input and platform integration; this release brings that path up on device.
details: It used to crash immediately on launch. Three serial blockers were fixed: the graphics translation layer was never initialised in the SDL era (a guaranteed crash), 26.3's new OIT shaders index a fragment output array with a non-constant expression which GLSL ES forbids (so nearly every shader failed to compile), and the input bridge could not resolve symbols across linker namespaces.

entries.text: Changelog inside the app: a new changelog page and a redesigned update prompt let you browse every version's changes by category.
entries.markdown: **Changelog inside the app**: a new changelog page and a redesigned update prompt let you browse every version's changes by category.
details: The changelog now has a single source of truth: the website, the GitHub release notes and the app are generated from the same text.

entries.text: AI crash log analysis: after a crash, analyse the log with one tap to get a verdict plus technical details (expandable to the full log), rendered as Markdown.
entries.markdown: **AI crash log analysis**: after a crash, analyse the log with one tap to get a verdict plus technical details (expandable to the full log), rendered as Markdown.
details: Analysis and log sharing are powered by [logshare.cn](https://logshare.cn): the same place uploads a log and returns a shareable link to attach to your report.

entries.text: Activity ledger: every activity (download / install / repair / launch) keeps a complete, correctly attributed record.
entries.markdown: **Activity ledger**: every activity (download / install / repair / launch) keeps a complete, correctly attributed record.

entries.text: Removed driver round-trips from the per-frame and per-upload paths, and upgraded MobileGlues.
Download speed no longer flips between MB, KB and bytes; it is computed from cumulative byte/time deltas.
Per-host address family selection, so mirrors with unreachable IPv6 no longer slow everything down.

No more 30-second wait before a loader installer starts (checksum side-car probing is now concurrent with a short timeout), and small files are no longer split into segments that each pay a handshake.
Redesigned the crash diagnosis layout and promoted log sharing to its own card.
Download speed problems fixed at the root: mods crawling at 11.5 KB/s, client.jar stalling for 57 seconds near the end, and slow loader installation were each traced to a distinct cause.
entries.markdown: **Download speed problems fixed at the root**: mods crawling at 11.5 KB/s, `client.jar` stalling for 57 seconds near the end, and slow loader installation were each traced to a distinct cause.
details: Mods: the throughput probe's verdict was discarded in favour of hard-coded official-first routing, and the official source 307-redirects some devices to an unreachable host.
End-of-transfer stalls: the tail was monopolised by three or four 7 KB/s zombie connections; the tail can now be re-segmented and slow connections can be preempted.

Loader installation: a stray path segment in the BMCLAPI mirror URL always returned 404, single-segment transfers were repeatedly killed by the low-speed watchdog, and installer downloads reported no progress at all.

entries.text: Legacy Forge (1.12.2 / 1.11.2 …) failed to install every time: the installer's internal path carried a leading slash and was rejected by an over-strict safety check.
entries.markdown: **Legacy Forge (1.12.2 / 1.11.2 …) failed to install every time**: the installer's internal path carried a leading slash and was rejected by an over-strict safety check.

entries.text: Fabric installation left a stray entry in the version list: Fabric now installs inside the sandbox like Forge and NeoForge.
entries.markdown: **Fabric installation left a stray entry in the version list**: Fabric now installs inside the sandbox like Forge and NeoForge.

entries.text: Forge deep repair now reuses the full installation pipeline instead of re-running the installer in place, which greatly improves its success rate.
entries.markdown: **Forge deep repair now reuses the full installation pipeline** instead of re-running the installer in place, which greatly improves its success rate.

entries.text: Three serious logging defects: 96.8% of records dropped under bursts, game logs wiped on every launch, and crash diagnosis giving destructive advice for healthy sessions while the upload path was not redacted.
MC 26.3 rendering washed out (sRGB encoded twice).
Completed the native interfaces for virtual controls in release builds.
A launch crash caused by module initialisation order under a circular import.
MC 26.2 with the Sodium mod still has known problems: scrambled terrain and severe stutter on some devices, unresolved in this release. Vanilla 26.x without Sodium is unaffected.
entries.markdown: **MC 26.2 with the Sodium mod still has known problems**: scrambled terrain and severe stutter on some devices, unresolved in this release. **Vanilla 26.x without Sodium is unaffected.**
details: Related problems that this release did fix: worlds showing only the HUD with "void" terrain and textures, and colour bars after opening F3.
Several attempts at the terrain scrambling and the stutter were all disproved on device and reverted, so they remain open; work continues.

entries.text: MC 26.3 is a snapshot / preview version and is still being adapted: it reaches the main menu and worlds but is not guaranteed to be stable.
The attached HAP is unsigned; sign it yourself before sideloading.
entries.markdown: The attached HAP is **unsigned**; sign it yourself before sideloading.

en.summary: This release brings up Minecraft 26.3's new SDL3 stack, overhauls the download and logging paths, and puts the changelog inside the app for the first time.

entries.text: 下载器断点续传、分段调度和镜像连接稳定性。
Gitee JDK 镜像分卷，降低并行下载长尾。
JDK 下载失败、卡住、取消后重试无响应，以及阶段进度异常。
下载尾段异常重下，以及 NeoForge 安装依赖下载长时间停顿。
本版是紧急修复版本，建议所有 1.0.0 用户升级。

zh.summary: 1.0.0 的下载相关紧急修复，不包含新的大型功能。

entries.text: Resumable downloads, segment scheduling and mirror connection stability.
Split Gitee JDK mirror volumes to cut the long tail of parallel downloads.
JDK downloads failing, stalling, or not responding to retry after cancellation, plus wrong stage progress.
Spurious re-downloads near the end of a transfer, and long stalls while fetching NeoForge install dependencies.
This is a hotfix release; upgrading is recommended for every 1.0.0 user.

en.summary: A hotfix for the download stack in 1.0.0. No new major features.

releases.title: 首个正式版：触摸手感与按键布局大跃进
releases.titleEn: First stable release, reworked touch and key layout

entries.text: 按键布局编辑器全面重做：单一浮层编辑器聚合编辑 / 样式 / 全局 / 手柄 / 方案 / 多选六个分页。
entries.markdown: **按键布局编辑器全面重做**：单一浮层编辑器聚合编辑 / 样式 / 全局 / 手柄 / 方案 / 多选六个分页。
details: 虚拟按键**自动对齐吸附**：对齐虚线 + 边/中心/相邻间距 + 黏滞轴锁定，摆放整齐不再靠手感。
**多选批量操作**：一键对齐、等间距、批量改样式、锁定、复制、删除，支持成组拖动。
布局方案支持鸿蒙原生分享导出、导入前分析（设备类型 / 合法性 / 旧版检测）、方案改名与按设备重置预设。
点击 `.json` 文件可经系统「打开方式」直接导入布局方案。
方案列表改为瀑布式紧凑排版，缩略图按**真实屏幕比例**还原（手机 / 平板各自比例）。

entries.text: 触摸输入体验重做：视角 look 手感基于时间平滑并可选加速，高低帧率下一致更跟手。
entries.markdown: **触摸输入体验重做**：视角 look 手感基于时间平滑并可选加速，高低帧率下一致更跟手。
details: **彻底根治「从菜单返回游戏视角瞬移」**：光标模型双量隔离，结构性解决而非补偿。
输入子系统下一代架构落地：C 层单一真相源解释器 + 输入台账，收口生命周期与线程安全。

entries.text: 游戏语言选择：全局默认 + 单版本可跟随 / 可独立，由启动器权威写入 options.txt。
entries.markdown: **游戏语言选择**：全局默认 + 单版本可跟随 / 可独立，由启动器权威写入 `options.txt`。

entries.text: 物品栏直点：点屏幕底部物品栏直接切格，免数字键，默认开启并自动对齐。
entries.markdown: **物品栏直点**：点屏幕底部物品栏直接切格，免数字键，默认开启并自动对齐。

entries.text: 系统功能按钮（输入 / 设置 / 显示）统一为可移动、不可删除的按钮。
完整支持 F3+F4 等「按住 + 点按」跨菜单组合键。
游戏内按键名正常显示（W / A / S / D / Space，不再是 key.keyboard.x）。
entries.markdown: 游戏内按键名正常显示（W / A / S / D / Space，不再是 `key.keyboard.x`）。

entries.text: 网络检测：全局网络异常横幅 + 分层诊断面板，可自证「能上网但连不上下载源」。
entries.markdown: **网络检测**：全局网络异常横幅 + 分层诊断面板，可自证「能上网但连不上下载源」。

entries.text: 第三方皮肤站（authlib-injector / LittleSkin）启动闪退。
entries.markdown: **第三方皮肤站（authlib-injector / LittleSkin）启动闪退**。

entries.text: 物品栏直点对齐、编辑器面板超屏被截断、chip 状态不刷新等编辑器问题。
知识产权 / 去品牌化 / 备案合规调整（应对上架审核）。
本版改动较大，尤其是触摸输入与布局编辑器；遇崩溃、安装失败或手感异常请务必反馈。
附件为 unsigned HAP，需用 HoKit 自行签名侧载安装。
entries.markdown: 附件为 **unsigned HAP**，需用 HoKit 自行签名侧载安装。

zh.summary: AMCL 迎来 1.0.0 正式版。本版是「触摸手感 + 按键布局」的一次大跃进，配套完成了游戏语言、网络诊断与上架合规。

entries.text: On-screen key layout editor rebuilt: one floating editor with six tabs (edit / style / global / gamepad / presets / multi-select).
entries.markdown: **On-screen key layout editor rebuilt**: one floating editor with six tabs (edit / style / global / gamepad / presets / multi-select).
details: **Snap alignment** for virtual keys: guide lines, edge / center / neighbour spacing and sticky axis locking.
**Batch editing on multi-select**: align, distribute, restyle, lock, duplicate, delete, and drag as a group.
Layout presets support HarmonyOS native share export, pre-import analysis (device type / validity / legacy detection), renaming and per-device preset reset.
Tapping a `.json` file can import a layout preset straight through the system "open with" dialog.
The preset list uses a compact masonry layout with thumbnails rendered at the **real screen aspect ratio** for phone and tablet.

entries.text: Touch input reworked: look sensitivity is now time-based with optional acceleration, so it feels the same at high and low frame rates.
entries.markdown: **Touch input reworked**: look sensitivity is now time-based with optional acceleration, so it feels the same at high and low frame rates.
details: **The "camera jumps after returning from a menu" bug is fixed structurally**, by separating the two cursor quantities instead of compensating for the drift.
Next-generation input architecture landed: a single-source-of-truth interpreter in C plus an input ledger that owns lifetime and thread safety.

entries.text: In-game language selection: a global default plus per-version follow-or-override, written authoritatively into options.txt by the launcher.
entries.markdown: **In-game language selection**: a global default plus per-version follow-or-override, written authoritatively into `options.txt` by the launcher.

entries.text: Direct hotbar tap: tap the hotbar at the bottom of the screen to switch slots without number keys, on by default and auto-aligned.
entries.markdown: **Direct hotbar tap**: tap the hotbar at the bottom of the screen to switch slots without number keys, on by default and auto-aligned.

entries.text: System function buttons (input / settings / display) are now movable but non-deletable.
Full support for hold-and-tap combos such as F3+F4 across menus.
In-game key names render properly (W / A / S / D / Space instead of key.keyboard.x).
entries.markdown: In-game key names render properly (W / A / S / D / Space instead of `key.keyboard.x`).

entries.text: Network diagnostics: a global connectivity banner plus a layered diagnostic panel that can prove "online but cannot reach the download source".
entries.markdown: **Network diagnostics**: a global connectivity banner plus a layered diagnostic panel that can prove "online but cannot reach the download source".

entries.text: Crash on launch with third-party skin services (authlib-injector / LittleSkin).
entries.markdown: **Crash on launch with third-party skin services** (authlib-injector / LittleSkin).

entries.text: Editor issues: hotbar tap alignment, panels clipped off-screen, chip state not refreshing.
IP / de-branding / filing compliance adjustments for store review.
Large change set, especially touch input and the layout editor; please report crashes, install failures or input anomalies.
The attached HAP is unsigned; sign it yourself with HoKit before sideloading.
entries.markdown: The attached HAP is **unsigned**; sign it yourself with HoKit before sideloading.

en.summary: AMCL reaches 1.0.0. This release is a large step forward for touch feel and on-screen key layout, rounded out by in-game language selection, network diagnostics and store-compliance work.

releases.title: NeoForge 支持与手机端沙箱外存储
releases.titleEn: NeoForge support and external storage on phones

entries.text: NeoForge 模组加载器支持（真机跑通）：与 Fabric / Forge 平级，安装、启动、模组管理全链路打通。
entries.markdown: **NeoForge 模组加载器支持**（真机跑通）：与 Fabric / Forge 平级，安装、启动、模组管理全链路打通。

entries.text: 手机端沙箱外存储：游戏数据可落在 下载/com.amcl.launcher 公共目录，卸载应用后存档与版本不丢失。

entries.text: 第三方皮肤站登录（authlib-injector / Yggdrasil）：支持 LittleSkin 等外置登录站，多角色切换、皮肤披风显示。
entries.markdown: **第三方皮肤站登录（authlib-injector / Yggdrasil）**：支持 LittleSkin 等外置登录站，多角色切换、皮肤披风显示。

entries.text: 已装模组完整性校验：损坏检测 + 一键修复，支持 CurseForge 指纹反查与来源自动收编，未知来源不误判损坏。
entries.markdown: **已装模组完整性校验**：损坏检测 + 一键修复，支持 CurseForge 指纹反查与来源自动收编，未知来源不误判损坏。

entries.text: 内置文档中心 + JIT 指引：启动前检查与 Forge 安装前的 JIT 拦截新增「如何解决」跳转；设置页新增「常见问题」。
entries.markdown: **内置文档中心 + JIT 指引**：启动前检查与 Forge 安装前的 JIT 拦截新增「如何解决」跳转；设置页新增「常见问题」。

entries.text: 关于页：软件信息、GitHub、联系方式、QQ 群、检查更新。
entries.markdown: **关于页**：软件信息、GitHub、联系方式、QQ 群、检查更新。

entries.text: 中文模组搜索：模糊匹配 + Modrinth 按 slug 直取 + 繁转简，修复「机械动力」等中文词搜不到、结果被高下载无关项淹没的问题。
entries.markdown: **中文模组搜索**：模糊匹配 + Modrinth 按 slug 直取 + 繁转简，修复「机械动力」等中文词搜不到、结果被高下载无关项淹没的问题。

entries.text: 全链路缓存提速：模组搜索结果、模组图标、MC 版本清单均加缓存；译名库改为本地优先，冷启动模组列表直接显示中文名。
entries.markdown: **全链路缓存提速**：模组搜索结果、模组图标、MC 版本清单均加缓存；译名库改为本地优先，冷启动模组列表直接显示中文名。

entries.text: 消除模组列表「加载球转完仍闪现『暂无结果』再出列表」的双搜竞态。
各处「去下载页」跳转只切大 Tab、不定位到模组 / 资源包 / 光影二级子页。
模组下载页「升级到该版本」只新增文件而未替换旧版。
原版 MC 26.x 经 MobileGlues 的低帧与物品栏 / 手部花屏（缓冲直写 + 帧边界栅栏）。
下载任务详情页速度 / 已下载 / 剩余不刷新。
平板端 sheet 取消系统右上角关闭按钮，避免与功能按钮重叠。
移除多余的 JIT 受限权限声明，与发布 Profile 对齐。
本版改动量大且多为真机验证特性，遇崩溃 / 安装失败 / 启动问题请务必反馈，附日志更佳。

zh.summary: 内容最厚的一次 beta：两个重量级新特性打头，其余覆盖第三方皮肤站登录、模组完整性校验、全链路缓存提速与内置文档中心。

entries.text: NeoForge mod loader support, verified on device: a first-class peer of Fabric and Forge across install, launch and mod management.
entries.markdown: **NeoForge mod loader support**, verified on device: a first-class peer of Fabric and Forge across install, launch and mod management.

entries.text: External storage on phones: game data can live in the public Download/com.amcl.launcher folder, so worlds and installed versions survive uninstalling the app.
entries.markdown: **External storage on phones**: game data can live in the public `Download/com.amcl.launcher` folder, so **worlds and installed versions survive uninstalling the app**.

entries.text: Third-party skin service login (authlib-injector / Yggdrasil): services such as LittleSkin, with multi-profile switching and skin/cape rendering.
entries.markdown: **Third-party skin service login (authlib-injector / Yggdrasil)**: services such as LittleSkin, with multi-profile switching and skin/cape rendering.
details: Added the missing HTTPS trust store inside the JVM so skin and session validation no longer fail.

entries.text: Integrity check for installed mods: damage detection with one-tap repair, CurseForge fingerprint lookup and automatic source adoption; unknown sources are not flagged as broken.
entries.markdown: **Integrity check for installed mods**: damage detection with one-tap repair, CurseForge fingerprint lookup and automatic source adoption; unknown sources are not flagged as broken.

entries.text: Built-in documentation centre and JIT guidance: the pre-launch check and the JIT gate before Forge installation now link to "how to fix"; settings gained a FAQ entry.
entries.markdown: **Built-in documentation centre and JIT guidance**: the pre-launch check and the JIT gate before Forge installation now link to "how to fix"; settings gained a FAQ entry.

entries.text: About page: app info, GitHub, contact, QQ group and update check.
entries.markdown: **About page**: app info, GitHub, contact, QQ group and update check.

entries.text: Chinese mod search: fuzzy matching, direct Modrinth slug lookup and traditional-to-simplified conversion, fixing terms like 机械动力 returning nothing and relevant hits drowning under high-download noise.
entries.markdown: **Chinese mod search**: fuzzy matching, direct Modrinth slug lookup and traditional-to-simplified conversion, fixing terms like 机械动力 returning nothing and relevant hits drowning under high-download noise.

entries.text: Caching across the board: mod search results, mod icons and the Minecraft version manifest are cached; the translation database is local-first, so the mod list shows Chinese names on a cold start.
entries.markdown: **Caching across the board**: mod search results, mod icons and the Minecraft version manifest are cached; the translation database is local-first, so the mod list shows Chinese names on a cold start.

entries.text: Removed the double-search race where the mod list flashed "no results" after the spinner finished.
"Go to downloads" links only switched the top-level tab instead of landing on the mods / resource pack / shader sub-page.
"Upgrade to this version" on the mod page added a file without replacing the old one.
Low frame rate and corrupted hotbar / hand rendering for vanilla MC 26.x through MobileGlues (direct buffer writes plus a frame-boundary fence).
Speed / downloaded / remaining figures not refreshing on the task detail page.
Removed the system close button from tablet sheets where it overlapped the function buttons.
Dropped a redundant JIT restricted-permission declaration to match the release profile.
Large change set, mostly device-verified features; please report crashes, install failures and launch problems with logs.

en.summary: The largest beta so far: two headline features, plus third-party skin login, mod integrity checking, caching across the board and a built-in documentation centre.

releases.title: 整合包一键安装与模组下载体验提升

entries.markdown: **One-tap modpack install**: install CurseForge / Modrinth modpacks online, or import `.mrpack` and CurseForge `.zip` files locally.

entries.markdown: **Chinese names**: mods, resource packs, shaders and modpacks show "Chinese name (English)", sourced from mcmod.cn and refreshed online.

entries.markdown: **Chinese search**: search directly for names such as 暮色森林, 匠魂 or 工业时代.

entries.markdown: **Open in browser**: jump to a resource page on Modrinth / CurseForge, or to its MC Encyclopaedia (mcmod) page.

entries.markdown: **Faster downloads**: multi-source segmented transfers with dynamic thread scaling; several mods or resources download in parallel, each with its own card and icon.

entries.text: Update checking now runs automatically at startup, showing a prompt and a red dot; it never interrupts an in-progress game.
Library download failures, false positives in the integrity check, and the loading screen not going fullscreen.

Unsigned sideload build; tablets and 2-in-1 devices are recommended for this release.
已装模组显示是否为最新版，可一键更新。
模组 / 资源包 / 光影 / 数据包本地导入。
存档管理板块，存档一键导入 / 导出。
版本列表长按拖拽排序；版本详情页可直接启动；版本说明可折叠展开。
问题反馈与崩溃日志一键上传。
未装 JDK 17 或 JIT 不可用时，Forge 安装前提前提示拦截。
聊天 / 输入框重构，能正常唤起系统输入法。
正版头像不显示、切换账号后信息不刷新。
停用兼容性较差的「新窗口模式」。

Local import for mods, resource packs, shaders and data packs.
A world management section with one-tap world import / export.
Long-press drag reordering in the version list, launching straight from the version detail page, and collapsible version notes.
One-tap upload for feedback and crash logs.
Forge installation is now gated with an early prompt when JDK 17 is missing or JIT is unavailable.
Rebuilt chat and text input so the system IME opens correctly.
Missing avatars for genuine accounts, and stale info after switching accounts.
The poorly compatible "new window mode" has been disabled.
This HAP is unsigned (DevEco default configuration); you need your own signature to install it. HarmonyOS NEXT API 20+ only.

entries.markdown: **检查更新**：手动检查 + 启动自动检查（24 小时节流）+ 首页 / 设置红点提示。

entries.text: 统一版本识别，支持中文路径与版本重命名。
JDK 按版本纪元自动路由，不再全局套用同一个 JDK。
下载提速：Forge 安装器与大文件走高并发分段。
检查更新改走 GitHub 代理镜像，解决国内直连被阻断。
Forge：多版本及 MC 26.1 启动崩溃；新增损坏深度修复（保护存档与模组）。
Fabric 的 JDK 路由与推荐版本判定错误。
Sodium / LWJGL 校验错误。
崩溃提示新增 JDK 不兼容判断，正常退出不再误弹。
HAP 未签名，需在已开启开发者模式的 HarmonyOS NEXT 设备上手动安装。

zh.summary: 从 alpha 进入 beta：启动链路更稳，新增完整性校验与检查更新。

entries.text: Pre-launch integrity check covering JIT, runtime, version files and assets; the sheet collapses automatically once everything passes.
entries.markdown: **Pre-launch integrity check** covering JIT, runtime, version files and assets; the sheet collapses automatically once everything passes.

entries.text: File integrity verification with automatic repair; damaged or leftover versions are flagged in red in version management and can be repaired or deleted.
Custom JVM arguments: global (settings) plus per-version (inline in version details), with user arguments taking precedence.
entries.markdown: **Custom JVM arguments**: global (settings) plus per-version (inline in version details), with user arguments taking precedence.

entries.text: Update checking: manual, automatic at startup (throttled to once per 24 h), with red dots on the home and settings entries.
entries.markdown: **Update checking**: manual, automatic at startup (throttled to once per 24 h), with red dots on the home and settings entries.

entries.text: Unified version detection, including Chinese paths and renamed versions.
The JDK is routed per version epoch instead of applying one runtime globally.
Faster downloads: the Forge installer and large files use highly concurrent segmented transfers.
Update checks go through GitHub proxy mirrors, working around blocked direct access in mainland China.
Forge: launch crashes on several versions and on MC 26.1; added deep repair for damaged installs that preserves worlds and mods.
Wrong JDK routing and recommended version for Fabric.
Sodium / LWJGL verification errors.
The crash prompt now recognises JDK incompatibility and no longer fires after a normal exit.
The HAP is unsigned and must be installed manually on a HarmonyOS NEXT device with developer mode enabled.

en.summary: Moving from alpha to beta: a sturdier launch path, integrity checking and update checking.

releases.title: 修复 Fabric 1.21.x 崩溃，新增外置存储
releases.titleEn: Fabric 1.21.x crash fix and external storage

entries.text: 修复 Fabric 1.21.x 启动崩溃：vanilla 与 Fabric Loader 同时携带不同版本 ASM 库（如 9.6 / 9.9）导致 classpath 重复、启动闪退。
entries.markdown: **修复 Fabric 1.21.x 启动崩溃**：vanilla 与 Fabric Loader 同时携带不同版本 ASM 库（如 9.6 / 9.9）导致 classpath 重复、启动闪退。
details: 合并 libraries 时按 Maven `groupId:artifactId` 去重并保留最高版本；已安装版本无需重装即可生效。

entries.text: 游戏数据外置目录：可把 .minecraft 存到 Download/com.amcl.launcher/，卸载应用后游戏文件保留。
entries.markdown: **游戏数据外置目录**：可把 `.minecraft` 存到 `Download/com.amcl.launcher/`，卸载应用后游戏文件保留。
details: 设置页可切换「沙箱 / 外部」存储位置，切换时按需申请权限并自动迁移已安装版本。
外部目录在系统文件管理器中显示为 AMCL 来源入口，便于手动管理游戏文件。

entries.text: 外置存储仅平板 / 2in1 可用：手机因系统对 READ_WRITE_DOWNLOAD_DIRECTORY 权限支持受限，无法可靠地把 JVM 游戏数据写入公共 Download 目录，请继续使用默认沙箱存储。
entries.markdown: 外置存储**仅平板 / 2in1 可用**：手机因系统对 `READ_WRITE_DOWNLOAD_DIRECTORY` 权限支持受限，无法可靠地把 JVM 游戏数据写入公共 Download 目录，请继续使用默认沙箱存储。

entries.text: HAP 仍为未签名构建，真机安装方式与此前 release 相同。
Fixed the Fabric 1.21.x launch crash caused by vanilla and Fabric Loader shipping different ASM versions (9.6 / 9.9), which duplicated classpath entries.
entries.markdown: **Fixed the Fabric 1.21.x launch crash** caused by vanilla and Fabric Loader shipping different ASM versions (9.6 / 9.9), which duplicated classpath entries.
details: Library merging now de-duplicates by Maven `groupId:artifactId` and keeps the highest version; existing installs benefit without reinstalling.

entries.text: External game data directory: .minecraft can live in Download/com.amcl.launcher/, so game files survive uninstalling the app.
entries.markdown: **External game data directory**: `.minecraft` can live in `Download/com.amcl.launcher/`, so game files survive uninstalling the app.
details: Settings can switch between sandbox and external storage, requesting permissions on demand and migrating installed versions automatically.
The external directory appears as an AMCL source in the system file manager for manual management.

entries.text: External storage is tablet / 2-in-1 only: on phones the system's limited READ_WRITE_DOWNLOAD_DIRECTORY support cannot reliably let the JVM write game data into the public Download folder, so keep the default sandbox storage.
entries.markdown: External storage is **tablet / 2-in-1 only**: on phones the system's limited `READ_WRITE_DOWNLOAD_DIRECTORY` support cannot reliably let the JVM write game data into the public Download folder, so keep the default sandbox storage.

entries.text: The HAP is still an unsigned build; install it the same way as previous releases.
JDK 25 运行时支持：完成 JDK 25 在 HarmonyOS NEXT 上的适配，可运行依赖 Java 25 的新版本 Minecraft。
entries.markdown: **JDK 25 运行时支持**：完成 JDK 25 在 HarmonyOS NEXT 上的适配，可运行依赖 Java 25 的新版本 Minecraft。
details: 与既有 JDK 17 / 21 多版本运行时并存，按 MC 版本自动路由。

entries.text: Minecraft 26.2（Pre-Release）支持：补齐 26.2 启动所需的全部 LWJGL 原生库（freetype / shaderc / spvc / vma）。
entries.markdown: **Minecraft 26.2（Pre-Release）支持**：补齐 26.2 启动所需的全部 LWJGL 原生库（`freetype` / `shaderc` / `spvc` / `vma`）。
details: 26.2 现可在鸿蒙设备上通过 OpenGL（MobileGlues）后端正常进入游戏。

entries.text: 多项启动崩溃问题。
选择 Vulkan 时自动回退到 OpenGL，不再崩溃；游戏内误选 Vulkan 也会在下次启动时自动纠正。
暂不支持 Vulkan：Minecraft 26.2 内置的官方 Vulkan 后端依赖当前华为 Maleoon GPU 驱动尚未提供的扩展（VK_KHR_dynamic_rendering / VK_KHR_push_descriptor）。适配代码已就位，待驱动升级后即可启用。
entries.markdown: **暂不支持 Vulkan**：Minecraft 26.2 内置的官方 Vulkan 后端依赖当前华为 Maleoon GPU 驱动尚未提供的扩展（`VK_KHR_dynamic_rendering` / `VK_KHR_push_descriptor`）。适配代码已就位，待驱动升级后即可启用。

entries.text: 当前推荐使用默认的 OpenGL（MobileGlues） 渲染后端获得最佳兼容性。
entries.markdown: 当前推荐使用默认的 **OpenGL（MobileGlues）** 渲染后端获得最佳兼容性。

entries.text: JDK 25 runtime support: JDK 25 has been ported to HarmonyOS NEXT, so Minecraft versions that require Java 25 can run.
entries.markdown: **JDK 25 runtime support**: JDK 25 has been ported to HarmonyOS NEXT, so Minecraft versions that require Java 25 can run.
details: It coexists with the existing JDK 17 / 21 runtimes and is routed automatically per Minecraft version.

entries.text: Minecraft 26.2 (pre-release) support: added every LWJGL native library 26.2 needs to boot (freetype, shaderc, spvc, vma).
entries.markdown: **Minecraft 26.2 (pre-release) support**: added every LWJGL native library 26.2 needs to boot (`freetype`, `shaderc`, `spvc`, `vma`).
details: 26.2 now reaches the game on HarmonyOS devices through the OpenGL (MobileGlues) backend.

entries.text: Several launch crashes.
Selecting Vulkan now falls back to OpenGL instead of crashing, and an in-game Vulkan selection is corrected on the next launch.

Vulkan is not supported yet: the official Vulkan backend in Minecraft 26.2 needs extensions the current Huawei Maleoon GPU driver does not expose (VK_KHR_dynamic_rendering, VK_KHR_push_descriptor). The adaptation code is in place and will be enabled once the driver supports them.
entries.markdown: **Vulkan is not supported yet**: the official Vulkan backend in Minecraft 26.2 needs extensions the current Huawei Maleoon GPU driver does not expose (`VK_KHR_dynamic_rendering`, `VK_KHR_push_descriptor`). The adaptation code is in place and will be enabled once the driver supports them.

entries.text: Stay on the default OpenGL (MobileGlues) backend for the best compatibility.
entries.markdown: Stay on the default **OpenGL (MobileGlues)** backend for the best compatibility.

releases.title: 虚拟按键与输入体验重构
releases.titleEn: Virtual keys and input experience rework

entries.text: 虚拟按键全面重构：统一为大小一致的方形按键，框内自动显示绑定键名；新增「添加按键」与全键盘改键，设置面板可拖动可滚动。
entries.markdown: **虚拟按键全面重构**：统一为大小一致的方形按键，框内自动显示绑定键名；新增「添加按键」与全键盘改键，设置面板可拖动可滚动。

entries.text: 多键组合：支持 F3+F4 切换游戏模式等组合键。
按住按键拖动瞄准：蓄力弓箭 / 举盾时可拖动视角。
按键显示场景切换（游戏中 / 菜单）。
内置手机 / 平板两套精简默认布局，并新增全局透明度调节。
聊天框输入：可正常呼出输入法并实时同步到游戏聊天框；存档搜索、创造物品栏、JEI 等游戏内文本框也可输入。

zh.summary: 本次主要优化虚拟按键与输入体验。

entries.text: Virtual keys rebuilt: uniform square keys that display their bound key name, an "add key" flow, full-keyboard rebinding, and a draggable, scrollable settings panel.
entries.markdown: **Virtual keys rebuilt**: uniform square keys that display their bound key name, an "add key" flow, full-keyboard rebinding, and a draggable, scrollable settings panel.

entries.text: Multi-key combos such as F3+F4 for switching game mode.
Hold-and-drag aiming: move the camera while drawing a bow or raising a shield.
Per-scene key visibility (in game / in menus).
Two built-in minimal default layouts for phone and tablet, plus a global opacity control.
Chat input: the IME opens and syncs live into the in-game chat box; world search, the creative inventory and JEI text fields accept input too.

en.summary: This release focuses on virtual keys and the input experience.
